lines.zh: 我一步一步走，肚子离地很近。
lines.en: I walk step by step, my belly close to the ground.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上留下一串印。
lines.en: My claws leave a line of prints.
I swing side to side as I walk, unhurried.

lines.zh: 我沿着阳光走，找个暖的地方。
lines.en: I follow the sunlight looking for a warm spot.

lines.zh: 我的舌头伸出来，又缩回去。
lines.en: My tongue flickers out and back.

lines.zh: 我从沙地上穿过，尾巴划出一道。
lines.en: I cross the sand and my tail draws a line.
I reach a stone and climb onto it.

lines.zh: 我钻进草丛，草叶朝两边倒。
lines.en: I push into the grass and it parts.
I loop around a tree root.

lines.zh: 我拖着尾巴走，痕迹很长。
lines.en: I drag my tail and the trail runs long.
I keep along the edge of the brush.

lines.zh: 我的头抬起来，又慢慢放下。
lines.en: I lift my head, then lower it slowly.
I am sunning myself; do not disturb me.

lines.zh: 我的舌头时不时探出来。
lines.en: My tongue flicks out now and then.
My breathing is slow.
This stone is warm just right.

lines.zh: 我睁着一只眼，另一只半闭着。
lines.en: One eye is open, the other half shut.
I do not go chasing anyone.
The grass moves and I look.

lines.zh: 我把自己摊开，晒得均匀些。
lines.en: I spread out to sun myself evenly.

lines.zh: 这附近没有比我大的东西。
lines.en: Nothing here is bigger than me.
My heartbeat has slowed.
My claws grip the stone's edge.
I turn my head slowly to the sun.

lines.zh: 我从石头上抬起头看你。
lines.en: I raise my head from the stone and look at you.
I turn my head and size you up.
My tongue flicks out once.
I press my body down again.
I lie flat under the Brazilian sun.
I shift slowly to the stone's edge.
You're blocking my sunbath.
I am not alarmed; I look first.

lines.zh: 我抬起前半身，撑起自己。
lines.en: I lift my front and prop myself up.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴轻轻拍了一下。
lines.en: My tail taps once.
How long do you intend to stand there?

lines.zh: 我看了你一眼，又趴回去。
lines.en: I look at you once and lie back down.
My chin rests on the stone.
I was here first.
I have no intention of hiding.

lines.zh: 我朝着你张开嘴，只是热。
lines.en: I open my mouth at you; it is only the heat.
I close my eyes again.
I twist and crawl aside.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片被蹭掉了几片。
lines.en: A few scales have been scraped off.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，发出低低的声。
lines.en: I open my mouth and hiss low.
I scrape my way back a distance.

lines.zh: 这一下疼得我尾巴乱甩。
lines.en: The pain makes my tail thrash.
I am still moving, slowly.
One leg is dragging a little.
Blood is on my jaw.
I raise my head and stare at you.
Is that an egg or meat?
I have climbed down toward you.
Eggs; I know that smell.
I come closer slowly, in no hurry.

lines.zh: 你手上那东西给我看看。
lines.en: Let me see what you are holding.
My neck stretches out long.
That is one mouthful for me.
I shuffled in one more small step.
I flick my tongue out to taste.
Food is hard to find around here.

lines.zh: 你撞我，我的身体很结实。
lines.en: You hit me; my body is solid.
I slide a little, then stop.

lines.zh: 我转身，用尾巴扫了一下。
lines.en: I turn and sweep my tail.

lines.zh: 这一下撞在鳞上，没什么。
lines.en: That landed on scales; nothing.
My scales rattle faintly.
I lower myself and shift aside.
I slid beneath the rock ledge.
I crawl slowly back onto the stone.

lines.zh: 到这个季节，我们就这样。
lines.en: In this season, this is what we do.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后，进了草丛。
lines.en: We go into the grass, one behind the other.
My tail is held very low.
We press against each other.

lines.zh: 我轻轻咬了一下它的颈。
lines.en: I nip its neck lightly.
Afterwards I go back to my stone.
I do not do this often.

lines.zh: 我们在土里刨了一个坑。
lines.en: We dig a hollow in the earth.
I bite it and shake it twice.
This cannot be eaten.
I have swallowed it.
I carry it back up onto the stone.
I sniff once and set it down.
I am keeping this one.
Too hard; I cannot bite it.

lines.zh: 我的前爪一压，它动不了。
lines.en: One press of my forefoot pins it.
I push it into the grass.
I spat it out.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，朝那边看。
lines.en: I raise my head and look that way.
I have come down from the stone.
That sound is not right.
I flatten my body.
I crawl that way.
My tongue keeps working.
I approach slowly, in no hurry.
You have backed to the grass.
I held my mouth open a long time.
This time I will not lie still.
I smell the warmth of you.

lines.zh: 尾巴在身后硬成一根棍。
lines.en: My tail has gone stiff as a rod.
It will be on this open ground.
I follow you with my belly on the earth.
You go left; so do I.
I crawl slowly, but I do not stop.
I circle around behind the stone.
I keep to your smell.
You are faster than me; I know that.
I wait for you to stop on your own.
I am not hurried; I can outlast you.
I press it toward the stone.
This path ends at stone.
I have shifted forward again.

lines.zh: 我下巴的蓝斑，晒得发亮。
lines.en: The blue on my jowls shines in the sun.

lines.zh: 我的舌头伸出去又收回。
lines.en: My tongue out, then back.
I trail right behind it.
You turned your head.
I bite down and shake once.
My tail whips your leg.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，四只脚一起按。
lines.en: I pounce and pin with all four feet.
My claws dig into your hide.
That bite held fast.
My jaws shut and stay shut.

lines.zh: 我把你从石头上拖下来。
lines.en: I drag you off the stone.

lines.zh: 我的牙不算长，可力气够。
lines.en: My teeth are not long, but the grip is.
That bite slid right off.
My mouth is still open.
I draw back half a step and come again.
You kicked me and I did not let go.
There is blood in my mouth.
I used everything on that one.

lines.zh: 土坡上多了一只趴着的东西。
lines.en: Something has come to lie on the earth bank.
I crawl out of the grass.
A line of prints appears in the sand.
I come out from under the stone.
I stop in the sun.

lines.zh: 这一片的虫子应该不少。
lines.en: There should be plenty of insects here.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地爬上一块石头。
lines.en: I climb slowly onto a stone.
I land with very little sound.
This spot is warm enough.
I lie down for a while first.

lines.zh: 我又往沙子深处挪了挪。
lines.en: I shift a bit deeper into the sand.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看见一条没走过的路。
lines.en: I lift my head and see a path I have not taken.

lines.zh: 我停在土坡上，先看了一圈。
lines.en: I stop on the bank and look around first.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在沙上扫出一道弧。
lines.en: My tail sweeps an arc in the sand.
I rest a forepaw on the stone.
I intend to stay here a while.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的鳞，我往沙里钻。
lines.en: Fire bakes my scales; I dig into the sand.

lines.zh: 我摔在石头上，肚子磕了一下。
lines.en: I land on stone and my belly takes the hit.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，四脚朝天。
lines.en: The blast flips me onto my back.

lines.zh: 一股力让我动不了，我只能张着嘴。
lines.en: Some force holds me still, jaws open.

lines.zh: 我饿得连爬下石头都难。
lines.en: Hunger makes it hard to climb down even.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整条尾巴都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole tail goes stiff.

lines.zh: 底下什么都没有，我四脚乱抓。
lines.en: There is nothing beneath and all four feet claw.
